categories.main_business_segments: The company is a major supplier of securities quotation trading system software and securities information services in China. Main business segments include: (1) Software sales - providing securities trading systems, quotation analysis systems, and intelligent service systems to securities companies; (2) Maintenance services - offering software maintenance, upgrades, emergency support, and technical training; (3) Securities information services - providing authorized quotation services and financial data services to institutional and individual customers through platforms like Tongdaxin.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies including: terminal technology (hybrid programming with C++ and scripting), encoding and transmission technology (proprietary compression superior to XML/JSON), security and cryptography technology (commercial cryptography and information security), middleware technology (3 million TPS throughput), cloud computing technology, big data technology (distributed computing, real-time analytics), and artificial intelligence technology (NLP, deep learning, intelligent Q&A). Products utilize 'unified backend, multiple terminals' architecture supporting Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, and Web platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include over 90% of Chinese securities companies with brokerage business licenses, serving as institutional clients. End markets include securities trading firms, investment institutions, and individual retail investors. The company also serves internet users through free and premium versions of its Tongdaxin software platform, with user base exceeding 220 million securities investors in China as of August 2023.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China, with headquarters in Shenzhen. It maintains subsidiaries including Wuhan Tongdaxin Digital Technology Co., Ltd. and Wuhan Tongdaxin Software Technology Co., Ltd. International presence includes Tongdaxin Technology Hong Kong Limited. Domestic coverage spans all major securities exchanges (Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing) and international markets including Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the financial software supply chain. It sources financial data and market information from upstream providers (exchanges, index companies, research institutions) and delivers software products and information services directly to institutional clients (securities companies) and end-users (individual investors). The company acts as an integrator and value-added service provider rather than a raw material or infrastructure provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing commercial cryptography and information security systems; (2) developing domestic alternative (信创) software products; (3) building 'multi-terminal coordinated digital middleware platform'; (4) expanding AI and generative AI applications (ChatGPT-like capabilities); (5) enhancing cloud computing and big data analytics; (6) developing low-code development platforms; (7) expanding securities information services and data resources; (8) supporting digital transformation of the securities industry. R&D investment represents 17.36% of revenue with 340 research personnel.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through three primary models: (1) Software product sales - direct B2B sales to securities companies with perpetual or subscription licenses; (2) Maintenance services - recurring annual fees (typically percentage of software contract value) for ongoing support and updates; (3) Securities information services - subscription-based SaaS model with tiered pricing (basic quotation, professional research, premium decision-making tiers) offered through web and mobile platforms, with monthly and annual payment options.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the securities quotation trading software segment, main competitors include Tonghuashun and Dazhihui. The company maintains a strong competitive position as the leading supplier to institutional clients (securities companies), with advantages in system stability, compatibility, and customer stickiness. In securities information services, competition is more fragmented with multiple players in different niches. The company differentiates through comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and extensive customer relationships covering 90%+ of Chinese securities firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large scale software services provider with 2023 revenue of 434.67 million yuan (35.21% YoY growth) and net profit of 310.72 million yuan (102.35% YoY growth). Total assets reached 3.64 billion yuan as of end-2023 (7.96% growth). The company demonstrates strong profitability with 85.56% gross margin on main business and positive operating cash flow of 238.06 million yuan. Growth trajectory shows consistent double-digit revenue expansion with improving profitability and cash generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Key value propositions include: (1) Comprehensive integrated platform combining quotation, trading, research, and information services; (2) Superior technical architecture with high stability, low latency, and strong scalability; (3) Extensive financial data resources covering domestic and international markets; (4) Advanced AI and big data analytics capabilities for intelligent decision support; (5) Strong security and compliance features including commercial cryptography; (6) Customizable solutions supporting multiple terminals and use cases; (7) Proven reliability with 90%+ market penetration among Chinese securities firms; (8) Continuous innovation in emerging technologies (AI, cloud, blockchain) to support industry digital transformation.
